newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower as Europe slips off highs.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower as Europe slips off highs.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Friday as most European bourses slid in what brokers saw as a mild correction after running on highs.
The Stockholm general index closed 1.37 percent lower at 3,120.11, depressed by a weaker open on Wall Street in afternoon trade. Turnover was an average 3.13 billion crowns.
Market heavyweight Ericsson fell 8.5 crowns to 329.5 crowns, losing some of its recent gains notched up in the wake of a positive report by Salomon Brothers.
Stockholm's other heavyweight, drugs major Astra, closed 2.5 crowns lower at 148.5 crowns.
The share slid six crowns the day before after announcing sales of its ulcer drug Losec in the U.S. rose 28 percent to $1.02 billion in the first half of 1997 against a year ago.
Aerial maker Allgon jumped seven crowns to 130 crowns after being recommended as a buy by brokerage Matteus. Allgon fell on Thursday after posting six month earnings.
Industrial powder company Hoganas also bucked the trend, climbing seven crowns to 262 crowns after the managing director forecast a strong second half of 1997.
